craft_evidence.owned: none - evidence: PVH FY2025 10-K: ~1,000 factories in ~30 countries, "All of these factories were operated by independent manufacturers" (company-wide; not broken out by brand)
craft_evidence.makers: none on 60 men's PDPs read; licensees named only in the 10-K (Peerless men's tailored clothing, MBF Holdings footwear, US/Canada), not on product pages
craft_evidence.mills: 1 of 60 PDPs: Glen Plaid Wool-Blend Blazer (TX004240) names "the renowned Lardini mill in Italy" as fabric source (evidence, on page; Lardini is better known as a tailoring maker); New York Label Performance Sweater Polo says "technical knit blend sourced from Italy" (no name)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed, claim: PVH brand page and FY2025 10-K "Originally established in New York City", "since 1985"; usa.tommy.com meta "since 1985"; brand heritage page dates his first store, the People'
craft_evidence.process: no - PDPs give fabric descriptions and sourcing claims (regenerative/certified/recycled fibres) only; Tommy ICONS page says "decades of premium craftsmanship" (vague)
craft_evidence.reasoning: All 60 men's PDPs read state only "Imported", with no country, maker or process; one Factory-label blazer names Lardini as its fabric source. PVH's 10-K says all production is by independent manufacturers. The only other checkable facts are a dated founding (1985, New York) and fibre-sourcing claims.
